summary.short: Statutory Law 1581 of 2012 sets general personal-data rules for public and private entities: principles, consent, data subject rights, controller and processor duties, enforcement by the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (fines, suspension, closure), a national database register, and limits on cross-border transfers. In force from promulgation.
summary.long: Statutory Law 1581 of 2012 sets general rules for processing personal data in any database held by public or private entities, applying in Colombia and to controllers or processors abroad where Colombian law applies under international norms (Art. 2). Definitions are in Art. 3, and principles of legality, purpose, consent, accuracy, transparency, restricted access, security and confidentiality are in Art. 4. Sensitive data processing is prohibited except in listed cases, and children's and adolescents' data may not be processed except public data (Arts. 5-7). Data subjects may access, update and rectify their data and, in stated cases, revoke authorization or request deletion (Art. 8). Prior, informed authorization is required unless an exception applies (Arts. 9-10). Consultations must be answered within ten business days and complaints within fifteen business days (Arts. 14-15). Controllers and processors have listed duties, including internal policy manuals (Arts. 17-18). The Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio supervises compliance and may impose fines up to 2,000 legal monthly minimum wages, suspend processing for up to six months, or order temporary or definitive closure (Arts. 19-24). A public National Register of Databases is created (Art. 25). Transfers of personal data to countries without adequate protection are prohibited, subject to listed exceptions (Art. 26). Existing actors have six months to comply (Art. 28), and the law takes effect on promulgation (Art. 30).

notes: Part 1 of 5, covering Arts. 1 to 33 as shown in this file. The Court excerpt (Sentencia C-748/2011, editor insert, not operative text) declares Arts. 29, 30 and 31 of the bill inexequibles for breach of consecutividad and identidad, yet the consolidated text still shows them without that marker. Art. 27 appears both as 'PROYECTO DE LEY. INEXEQUIBLE' and as a restated 'Texto del Proyecto de Ley Anterior' version. Consolidated text marks Art. 8(e), Art. 19 and Art. 26(f) as conditionally constitutional; the excerpt calls Art. 26(f) imprecise. The excerpt holds that directing SIC fines to its own funding contradicts unity of cash; enacted Art. 20 lists only Presupuesto General appropriations. Passages marked 'Texto del Proyecto de Ley Anterior' are earlier wording and were not treated as enacted text. Part 2 of 5 contains the closing Art. 34 of the bill (Vigencia: the law takes effect upon promulgation) and, for most of its length, the Constitutional Court's review of the bill (Proyecto de Ley Estatutaria 046 de 2010 Cámara - 184 de 2010 Senado): procedural history, citizen interventions, the Procurador's opinion and the Court's reasoning. The bill texts quoted come from different stages (Gaceta 488 of 2010, Cámara committee and plenary, Senate committee and plenary) and are not the enacted text; no obligations, thresholds, enforcement or definitions are coded from this part. Relations and entities reflect the Cámara-approved text as quoted. Internal inconsistency: section 2.2.4.2 gives 31 of 35 votes for the committee approval and also 29 votes for the report, articles and title. Art. 34 is not coded here because only relations, entities and notes were requested for this part. Part 3 is mostly the Constitutional Court's review text quoting the bill (Arts. 1 to 4 and the drafting history). It is not the enacted text as numbered in the final law. The Court declares Arts. 29, 30 and 31 unconstitutional for breach of the consecutividad principle, so their content is not operative. Obligations, thresholds, definitions and enforcement in Arts. 1 to 4 are not coded in this part. Art. 2 cross-references are exclusions from the act's provisions, not incorporations. target_instrument_id is left empty because no registry ID was verified; the schema does not allow null. Part 4 is mainly the Constitutional Court's review of arts. 6 to 18 of the bill, with the bill text quoted in each section; it is not the statute text itself, so provision IDs point to the quoted articles and the Court section where they appear. The Court declares some words inexequible (e.g., 'el Titular haya hecho manifiestamente públicos o' in art. 6(d); 'solo' in art. 8(e)) and makes several provisions conditionally constitutional (arts. 6(d), 7, 8(e), 10, 12(b)); these readings are not coded as provisions of the statute. Art. 7 first and second paragraphs were said by interveners to conflict; the Court resolves this by interpretation. Directive 95/46/CE, the 2008 Convention, Court judgments and the Código Contencioso Administrativo are discussed but are not stated as relations of this statute, so they are not coded. Entities are limited to bodies the quoted bill text designates or empowers. Part 5 covers Arts. 19-28 and 32-34 of the statute, reproduced in a compilation that also contains the Constitutional Court's review. Court outcomes stated in the document: Art. 19 exequible on condition that the authority acts autonomously and independently; Art. 20 lit. a) inexequible; Art. 23 lit. a) phrase 'a favor de la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio' inexequible; Art. 26 lit. f) partly inexequible; Art. 27 inexequible; Arts. 29-31 inexequible for procedural defects (their text is not in this part). Internal inconsistency: the Court's reasoning on Art. 26 lit. f) declares the whole literal inexequible, but the operative decision strikes only the words 'necesarias o'. The reasoning also conditions lits. c), d) and e) on prior express authorisation, which the operative part does not repeat. The text reviewed is the bill (Proyecto 046/10 Cámara); whether it matches the enacted text cannot be verified from this part. Art. 19 par. 1 and Art. 32 set periods that are procedural or transitional and are not coded here.

obligations.summary: Intelligence and counter-intelligence databases must follow strictly the data processing parameters set in the National Intelligence Plan and the Joint Intelligence Board; a public official refusing information on reserve grounds must do so with reasons stated.

evidence.quote: deberán guiarse estrictamente por los parámetros de tratamiento de datos establecidos en el Plan Nacional de Inteligencia y por la Junta de Inteligencia Conjunta

obligations.summary: Reserve must be guaranteed to protect the identity of persons subject to intelligence reports, of intelligence officials, and their methods and sources; intelligence reports have no evidentiary value in judicial proceedings.

evidence.quote: En todo caso se garantizará la reserva para proteger la identidad de quienes son objeto de dichos informes

obligations.summary: Persons already carrying out regulated activities on the law's entry into force have a grace period of up to six months to adapt to its provisions.
obligations.applies_from: six months after entry into force of the law (up to)
obligations.conditional_on: Persons already carrying out regulated activities at entry into force

evidence.quote: tendrán un plazo de hasta seis (6) meses para adecuarse a las disposiciones contempladas en esta ley.

obligations.summary: Where personal databases or archives exempted under Art. 2(a) are to be supplied to third parties, the holder must be informed in advance and its authorisation requested; the responsible and processing parties then become subject to the law.
obligations.conditional_on: Personal databases or archives kept in an exclusively personal or domestic sphere are to be supplied to third parties

evidence.quote: Cuando estas bases de datos o archivos vayan a ser suministrados a terceros se deberá, de manera previa, informar al Titular y solicitar su autorización.

obligations.summary: The data protection principles of the law apply to all databases, including those excepted under Art. 2, within the limits of the law and without conflicting with data subject to legal reserve; where special rules for excepted databases provide principles, these apply concurrently.

evidence.quote: Los principios sobre protección de datos serán aplicables a todas las bases de datos, incluidas las exceptuadas en el presente artículo

obligations.summary: Processing must pursue a legitimate purpose under the Constitution and the law, and the purpose must be disclosed to the data subject (purpose principle).

evidence.quote: el tratamiento debe obedecer a una finalidad legítima de acuerdo con la Constitución y la ley, la cual debe ser informada al titular.

obligations.summary: Processing may only take place with the prior, express and informed consent of the data subject (freedom principle).
obligations.conditional_on: Absent a legal or judicial mandate that waives consent

evidence.quote: el tratamiento sólo puede ejercerse con el consentimiento, previo, expreso e informado del titular.

obligations.summary: Personal data may not be obtained or disclosed without prior authorisation, or without a legal or judicial mandate that overrides consent.
obligations.conditional_on: Absent a legal or judicial mandate that overrides consent

evidence.quote: Los datos personales no podrán ser obtenidos o divulgados sin previa autorización

obligations.summary: Information subject to processing must be truthful, complete, accurate, up to date, verifiable and comprehensible (accuracy principle); processing of partial, incomplete, fractionated or misleading data is prohibited.

evidence.quote: la información sujeta a tratamiento debe ser veraz, completa, exacta, actualizada, comprobable y comprensible.

obligations.summary: The controller or processor must guarantee the data subject's right to obtain, at any time and without restrictions, information on the existence of data concerning them (transparency principle).

evidence.quote: debe garantizarse el derecho del titular a obtener del responsable del tratamiento o del encargado del tratamiento

obligations.summary: Personal data other than public information may not be available on the internet or other mass media unless access is technically controllable and restricted to data subjects or authorised third parties.
obligations.conditional_on: Unless access is technically controllable for restricted knowledge

evidence.quote: no podrán estar disponibles en internet u otros medios de divulgación o comunicación masiva

obligations.summary: Information subject to processing must be handled with the technical, human and administrative measures necessary to secure records against tampering, loss, unauthorised consultation, use or access.

evidence.quote: se deberá manejar con las medidas técnicas, humanas y administrativas que sean necesarias para otorgar seguridad a los registros

obligations.summary: All persons involved in processing non-public personal data must keep the information confidential, including after their involvement ends, and may disclose it only as the law allows (confidentiality principle).
obligations.conditional_on: Data that do not have public character

evidence.quote: están obligadas a garantizar la reserva de la información

obligations.summary: For sensitive data processed for historical, statistical or scientific purposes, measures leading to suppression of the identity of the holders must be adopted.
obligations.conditional_on: Processing for historical, statistical or scientific purposes under Art. 6(e)

evidence.quote: deberán adoptarse las medidas conducentes a la supresión de identidad de los Titulares.

obligations.summary: Processing of personal data of children and adolescents must ensure respect for their prevailing rights.

evidence.quote: En el Tratamiento se asegurará el respeto a los derechos prevalentes de los niños, niñas y adolescentes.

obligations.summary: Responsables and Encargados must enable the data subject's rights to know, update and rectify data, request proof of authorization, be informed on use on request, lodge complaints before the SIC, revoke authorization or request deletion in listed cases, and access data free of charge.
obligations.conditional_on: Exercised on the request of the data subject

evidence.quote: Conocer, actualizar y rectificar sus datos personales frente a los Responsables del Tratamiento o Encargados del Tratamiento.

obligations.summary: Whoever accesses personal data without prior authorization in the cases of Art. 10 must nevertheless comply with the provisions of the law.
obligations.conditional_on: Access without prior authorization under Art. 10

evidence.quote: Quien acceda a los datos personales sin que medie autorización previa deberá en todo caso cumplir con las disposiciones contenidas en la presente ley.

obligations.summary: The Responsable must keep proof of compliance with the duty to inform and give a copy to the holder on request.
obligations.conditional_on: Copy to be given on request of the holder

evidence.quote: El Responsable del Tratamiento deberá conservar prueba del cumplimiento de lo previsto en el presente artículo

obligations.summary: Consultations must be answered within a maximum of ten business days from receipt; if not possible, the holder must be informed of the reasons and a date no later than five further business days.

evidence.quote: La consulta será atendida en un término máximo de diez (10) días hábiles contados a partir de la fecha de recibo de la misma.

obligations.summary: Claims (reclamos) must be processed: incomplete claims are returned for correction within five days, a 'reclamo en tramite' legend is added within two business days and kept until decided, and claims are answered within fifteen business days, extendable by up to eight business days with notice.

evidence.quote: el termino máximo para atender el reclamo será de quince (15) días hábiles

obligations.summary: The holder may complain to the SIC only after exhausting the consultation or claim procedure before the Responsable or Encargado.
obligations.conditional_on: Prior exhaustion of consultation or claim procedure

evidence.quote: El titular o causahabiente sólo podrá elevar queja ante la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio una vez haya agotado el tramite de consulta o reclamo ante el Responsable del Tratamiento o Encargado del Tratamiento.

obligations.summary: Responsables must guarantee the holder the full and effective exercise of habeas data at all times, and inform the holder on request about the use of their data.
obligations.conditional_on: Inform on use only upon request of the holder

evidence.quote: Garantizar al Titular, en todo tiempo, el pleno y efectivo ejercicio del derecho de hábeas data.

obligations.summary: Responsables must request and keep a copy of the holder's authorization under the law's conditions.

evidence.quote: Solicitar y conservar, en las condiciones previstas en la presente ley, copia de la respectiva autorización otorgada por el Titular.

obligations.summary: Responsables must duly inform the holder about the purpose of collection and the rights arising from the authorization.

evidence.quote: Informar debidamente al Titular sobre la finalidad de la recolección y los derechos que le asisten por virtud de la autorización otorgada.

obligations.summary: Responsables must keep information under security conditions preventing alteration, loss, unauthorised or fraudulent access, and must require the Encargado to respect security and privacy conditions.

evidence.quote: Conservar la información bajo las condiciones de seguridad necesarias para impedir su adulteración, pérdida, consulta, uso o acceso no autorizado o fraudulento.

obligations.summary: Responsables must ensure information given to the Encargado is accurate, complete, updated, verifiable and understandable; update and rectify it and notify the Encargado; and supply only data whose processing is authorized.

evidence.quote: Garantizar que la información que se suministre al Encargado del Tratamiento sea veraz, completa, exacta, actualizada, comprobable y comprensible.

obligations.summary: Responsables must process consultations and claims within the terms set by the law.

evidence.quote: Tramitar las consultas y reclamos formulados en los términos señalados en la presente ley.

obligations.summary: Responsables must adopt an internal manual of policies and procedures ensuring compliance with the law, especially for handling consultations and claims.

evidence.quote: Adoptar un manual interno de políticas y procedimientos para garantizar el adecuado cumplimiento de la presente ley

obligations.summary: Encargados must guarantee the holder the full and effective exercise of habeas data at all times and carry out timely updating, rectification or deletion of data.

evidence.quote: Garantizar al Titular, en todo tiempo, el pleno y efectivo ejercicio del derecho de hábeas data.

obligations.summary: Encargados must keep information under security conditions preventing alteration, loss, unauthorised or fraudulent access, and allow access only to persons entitled to it.

evidence.quote: Conservar la información bajo las condiciones de seguridad necesarias para impedir su adulteración, pérdida, consulta, uso o acceso no autorizado o fraudulento.

obligations.summary: Encargados must update information reported by Responsables within five business days of receipt; register the legends required by the law; and refrain from circulating information that is contested and whose blocking the SIC has ordered.

evidence.quote: Actualizar la información reportada por los Responsables del Tratamiento dentro de los cinco (5) días hábiles, contados a partir de su recibo.

obligations.summary: Encargados must process consultations and claims from holders within the terms set by the law.

evidence.quote: Tramitar las consultas y los reclamos formulados por los Titulares en los términos señalados en la presente ley.

obligations.summary: Encargados must adopt an internal manual of policies and procedures ensuring compliance with the law, especially for handling holders' consultations and claims.

evidence.quote: Adoptar un manual interno de políticas y procedimientos para garantizar el adecuado cumplimiento de la presente ley

obligations.summary: Encargados must inform the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio when security code violations occur and risks arise for holders' information.
obligations.conditional_on: Security code violations and risks to holders' information

evidence.quote: Informar a la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio cuando se presenten violaciones a los códigos de seguridad

obligations.summary: The Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio, through a Delegatura for personal data protection, exercises oversight to ensure that personal data processing respects the principles, rights, guarantees and procedures of the law.

evidence.quote: ejercerá la vigilancia para garantizar que en el Tratamiento de datos personales se respeten los Principios, derechos, garantías y procedimientos previstos en la presente ley

obligations.summary: The national government must incorporate a Superintendente Delegado post within the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio to exercise the functions of data protection authority.
obligations.applies_from: within six (6) months from the date of entry into force of the law

evidence.quote: El gobierno Nacional en el plazo de seis (6) meses contados a partir de la fecha de entrada en vigencia de la presente ley incorporará dentro de la estructura de la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio un despacho de Superintendente Delegado

obligations.summary: The Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio exercises listed functions: monitoring compliance; investigating and ordering measures to make habeas data effective; ordering temporary blocking of data; promoting data subject rights and public awareness campaigns; issuing instructions on measures for controllers and processors to comply; requesting information from controllers and processors; issuing conformity declarations on international transfers; administering the national registry of databases; recommending legal adjustments; and requesting cooperation from foreign entities.

evidence.quote: Velar por el cumplimiento de la legislación en materia de protección de datos personales.

obligations.summary: Persons registering databases must submit their data processing policies to the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio; these policies bind controllers and processors and may not fall below the duties of the law.
obligations.conditional_on: when registering databases in the National Registry of Databases

evidence.quote: los interesados deberán aportar a la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio las políticas de tratamiento de la información

obligations.summary: The national government must regulate the minimum information the National Registry of Databases must contain and the terms and conditions for registration of controllers.
obligations.applies_from: within one year after promulgation of the law

evidence.quote: El Gobierno nacional reglamentará, dentro del año siguiente a la promulgación de la presente Ley, la información mínima que debe contener el Registro

obligations.summary: The Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio issues conformity declarations for international transfers in cases not covered by the exceptions, and may request information and carry out proceedings to verify compliance.
obligations.conditional_on: cases not covered by the exceptions of Art. 26

evidence.quote: corresponderá a la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio, proferir la declaración de conformidad relativa a la transferencia internacional de datos personales

obligations.summary: The national government is to issue regulations on binding corporate rules for certification of good practices in personal data protection and their transfer to third countries.

evidence.quote: El Gobierno Nacional expedirá la reglamentación correspondiente sobre Normas Corporativas Vinculantes para la certificación de buenas prácticas en protección de datos personales y su transferencia a terceros países.

obligations.summary: Persons already carrying on activities regulated by the law at its entry into force must adapt to its provisions within a transition period of up to six months.
obligations.applies_from: from the date of entry into force of the law, with up to six (6) months to adapt

evidence.quote: tendrán un plazo de hasta seis (6) meses para adecuarse a las disposiciones contempladas en esta ley

enforcement.authority: Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (Delegatura para la Protección de Datos Personales), Art. 19
enforcement.triggered_by: Breach of the law by Responsables or Encargados del Tratamiento found under Art. 22; Art. 23 sanctions apply only to private persons (Art. 23 parágrafo)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: hasta por el equivalente de dos mil (2.000) salarios mínimos mensuales legales vigentes al momento de la imposición de la sanción
enforcement.penalty_formula: Up to 2,000 SMMLV at the time of imposition; fines may be successive while the breach persists; graduated under Art. 24 criteria (harm or danger, economic benefit, recidivism, obstruction, disobedience, admission)

evidence.quote: Multas de carácter personal e institucional hasta por el equivalente de dos mil (2.000) salarios mínimos mensuales legales vigentes al momento de la imposición de la sanción.

enforcement.authority: Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (Delegatura para la Protección de Datos Personales), Art. 19
enforcement.triggered_by: Breach of the law by Responsables or Encargados del Tratamiento found under Art. 22; applies only to private persons (Art. 23 parágrafo)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Suspensión de las actividades relacionadas con el Tratamiento hasta por un término de seis (6) meses; the suspension act must state the corrective measures to be adopted
enforcement.cure_period: the suspension act must state the corrective measures to be adopted; no separate cure period stated

evidence.quote: Suspensión de las actividades relacionadas con el Tratamiento hasta por un término de seis (6) meses.

enforcement.authority: Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (Delegatura para la Protección de Datos Personales), Art. 19
enforcement.triggered_by: Temporary closure of processing operations after the suspension period (Art. 23(b)) ends without the corrective measures ordered by the SIC having been adopted; applies only to private persons (Art. 23 parágrafo)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Cierre temporal de las operaciones relacionadas con el Tratamiento; no duration stated
enforcement.cure_period: applies only after the suspension term expires without the ordered corrective measures being adopted

evidence.quote: Cierre temporal de las operaciones relacionadas con el Tratamiento una vez transcurrido el término de suspensión sin que se hubieren adoptado los correctivos ordenados por la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio

enforcement.authority: Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (Delegatura para la Protección de Datos Personales), Art. 19
enforcement.triggered_by: Operation involving the processing of sensitive data (Art. 5 definition); text provides for immediate and definitive closure; applies only to private persons (Art. 23 parágrafo)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Cierre inmediato y definitivo de la operación que involucre el Tratamiento de datos sensibles

evidence.quote: Cierre inmediato y definitivo de la operación que involucre el Tratamiento de datos sensibles;

enforcement.authority: Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (Delegatura para la Protección de Datos Personales), Art. 19
enforcement.triggered_by: On the Titular's request and evidence, identification of a certain risk of violation of the holder's fundamental rights; the blocking must be necessary to protect them until a final decision is adopted
enforcement.cure_period: temporary, until a final decision is adopted

evidence.quote: Disponer el bloqueo temporal de los datos cuando, de la solicitud y de las pruebas aportadas por el Titular, se identifique un riesgo cierto de vulneración de sus derechos fundamentales

enforcement.triggered_by: Incumplimiento de las disposiciones de la presente ley por parte de los Responsables del Tratamiento o Encargados del Tratamiento (Art. 22)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: hasta por el equivalente de dos mil (2000) salarios mínimos mensuales legales vigentes en el momento de la imposición de la sanción
enforcement.penalty_formula: Multas sucesivas mientras subsista el incumplimiento que las originó; graduated under the criteria in Art. 24 (dimension of harm or danger, economic benefit, recidivism, obstruction, disregard of orders, acknowledgement). Applies only to private persons (Parágrafo). The expression 'a favor de la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio' was declared inexequible by the Court (Séptimo).

evidence.quote: Multas de carácter personal e institucional a favor de la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio hasta por el equivalente de dos mil (2000) salarios mínimos mensuales legales vigentes en el momento de la imposición de la sanción.

enforcement.triggered_by: Incumplimiento de las disposiciones de la presente ley por parte de los Responsables o Encargados del Tratamiento (Art. 22); the suspension act states the corrective measures to be adopted
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Suspensión de las actividades relacionadas con el tratamiento hasta por un término de seis (6) meses
enforcement.penalty_formula: Suspension of processing-related activities for up to six months; corrective measures to be indicated in the suspension act. Applies only to private persons (Parágrafo).

evidence.quote: Suspensión de las actividades relacionadas con el tratamiento hasta por un término de seis (6) meses.

enforcement.triggered_by: Corrective measures ordered under the suspension of processing activities have not been adopted once the suspension period has expired
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Cierre temporal de las operaciones relacionadas con el tratamiento una vez transcurrido el término de suspensión sin que se hubieran adoptado los correctivos ordenados por la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio
enforcement.penalty_formula: Temporary closure of processing-related operations; no duration stated in this text. Applies only to private persons (Parágrafo).

evidence.quote: Cierre temporal de las operaciones relacionadas con el tratamiento una vez transcurrido el término de suspensión sin que se hubieran adoptado los correctivos ordenados por la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio.

enforcement.triggered_by: Operation that involves the processing of sensitive data (as stated in the sanction provision)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Cierre inmediato y definitivo de la operación que involucre el tratamiento de datos sensibles
enforcement.penalty_formula: Immediate and definitive closure of the operation. Applies only to private persons (Parágrafo).

evidence.quote: Cierre inmediato y definitivo de la operación que involucre el tratamiento de datos sensibles.

thresholds.note: Arts. 19-34 in this part contain no numeric cutoff that changes legal treatment. The SMMLV fine ceiling and suspension period in Art. 23 are enforcement; the 6-month periods in Art. 19 par. 1 and Art. 32 are procedural time limits; the 1-year period in Art. 25 par. is a procedural deadline.
